The in-page bytes are not re-modeled. The layout inside this overflow space is module-advertised: each parameter's offset is computed from the accumulated MemoryLength attributes of the advertised VCS Descriptor, and a VCS Parameter must be fully contained within a page (§ 4.4), so individual parameter offsets and lengths inside this space are not recorded. Table 4-1 prints the in-page Staged Control Set 1 space as page 10h bytes 196-210, which is not the CMIS 5.3 base Staged Control Set 1 signal-integrity range (bytes 188-210) that § 4.5 requires the module to keep.
